subject: Intermittent latency spikes impacting charting - request for commercial exception & SLA path
messages:
From: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@acerahealth.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@acerahealth.com
Date: 2026-10-03T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Charting latency spikes since model update — urgent

Hi Aditya / Monica,

We're seeing intermittent latency spikes in our provider-facing charting UI starting late last Friday after you rolled the 2026-09-30 runtime changes. The UI stalls for 3–8s on ~15% of requests which is blocking a small subset of clinician workflows. This began after the new attention-optimizer was enabled for the rdx-small model.

This is material for us: our renewal is Q4 and we need clarity on root cause, mitigation timeline, and whether Redwood can commit to an SLA addendum while we evaluate a longer-term Dedicated pilot. Also need to understand commercial remediation (credits / pricing) for the instability window.

I've attached a small sample trace file and a CSV of observed latency instances. Please respond with next steps and who will own the investigation. We're on the East Coast and can jump on a call tomorrow morning if helpful.

— Samantha
Samantha Lowe
Head of ML Platform, Acera Health
attachments: acera_latency_sample.csv
From: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@acerahealth.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@acerahealth.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-04T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Charting latency spikes since model update — urgent

Hi Samantha — thank you for the details and the sample traces. Sorry for the disruption. I'm owning the case. Quick summary and planned actions: 

1) Triage: Monica's team confirmed the attention-optimizer flag was enabled in the rollout; we're reproducing the 3–8s tail latency on a subset of long-history requests.
2) Short-term mitigation: we can roll back the optimizer for Acera's tenant to restore prior p95 within 2 hours (we recommend this while we root-cause).
3) Medium-term: we'll run a focused experiment on your traffic shape in our staging fleet and propose a quantization/config tweak to avoid the regression. Target ETA for validated mitigation: 72 hours.
4) Commercial/remediation: Because this is a regression post-deploy and you have an upcoming renewal, I'm proposing two things: a) immediate one-time service credit covering the affected window, and b) a dedicated pilot offer with a short-term premium SLA addendum during the pilot. I need approval from my manager for the exact credit % and pilot discount.

Would you like us to rollback now or proceed with the staged fix? If you want the SLA addendum, I'll attach a draft and get it routed for DocuSign.

Next: looping in Lauren (sales lead) to approve the commercial exception and Monica (CS) to lead remediation.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: proposed_sla_addendum_v2.pdf, Acera_MutualActionPlan.xlsx
From: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-05T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Charting latency spikes since model update — urgent

Aditya / Monica — reviewed. We should prioritize a rollback to reduce customer impact while engineering validates the fix. Commercial stance: I'm willing to authorize a one-time credit equal to 10% of Acera's upcoming monthly invoice to cover the incident window, and a 20% discount on month 1 of a Dedicated pilot conversion (terms: 3-month pilot minimum). These are exceptions to standard policy but defensible given risk to renewal.

Conditions: 
- Credit contingent on acknowledgement that Redwood will provide a validated mitigation within 72 hours and a joint postmortem.
- SLA addendum will be time-limited to the pilot period (we won't extend enterprise SLA beyond pilot without a technical review).
- Finance needs to sign off; please tag billing/finance on the DocuSign and HubSpot.

Monica, please start the rollback plan and the pilot runbook referenced in the mutual action plan. Aditya, update Acera with the rollback window and commercial offer.

— Lauren Bishop
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
From: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@acerahealth.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@acerahealth.com>, procurement@acerahealth.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-06T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Charting latency spikes since model update — urgent

Hi Samantha / Marco — wanted to confirm next steps and timeline: 

1) Rollback: We'll roll back the attention-optimizer flag for Acera's tenant at 14:00 ET today (Oct 6). Monica's team will monitor p50/p95 for 6 hours post-rollback and share telemetry.
2) Commercial: Per Lauren's approval, Redwood will issue a one-time credit equal to 10% of October's invoice for the incident window and provide a 20% discount on month 1 of the Dedicated pilot (3-month pilot minimum). I've attached the SLA addendum draft and mutual action plan for your review.
3) Next call: Proposed 10/7 09:00 ET to review telemetry and finalize pilot scope. Please confirm availability.

Links/attachments referenced: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/7381 — Draft SLA Addendum: https://docusign.net/Acera-SLA-Addendum

Thanks again for the quick escalation. We're committed to resolving this and ensuring a smooth renewal path.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
phone: +1-415-555-0166
attachments: proposed_sla_addendum_v2.pdf, Acera_MutualActionPlan.xlsx
